summary:
Results-driven Full Stack Developer with 6 years of experience in designing and
delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications across banking,
healthcare, and manufacturing domains. Proficient in React.js, Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate,
SQL, Node.js, and .NET, with strong expertise in microservices architecture, API
development, and database optimization. Skilled in translating complex business
requirements into efficient technical solutions, ensuring data integrity, compliance, and
seamless user experience. Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to
deliver robust, enterprise-grade software solutions that drive business efficiency and
innovation.

bullets: Managerial Abilities:
Engineered scalable full-stack solutions leveraging Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Angular, React.js, and SQL, ensuring robustness and high availability across platforms.
Built dynamic, modular user interfaces using Angular and React.js, applying reusable components, efficient state management (Redux, Context API), and responsive design principles.
Designed interactive dashboards, forms, and visual analytics modules to improve user engagement and data visibility.
Developed and optimized RESTful APIs and microservices using Spring Boot and Node.js, delivering secure, high-performing, and maintainable backend services.
Integrated internal and third-party systems via REST, JSON, OAuth2, and JWT, ensuring secure authentication and data flow.
Created and tuned database schemas, stored procedures, queries, and indexes in SQL and Oracle for performance efficiency.
Implemented Hibernate/JPA for ORM and streamlined data operations in enterprise-grade environments.
Deployed containerized microservices using Docker, enabling modularity, portability, and simplified maintenance.
Contributed to architectural design and followed SOLID principles, design patterns, and coding best practices for scalable development.
Automated builds and deployments through CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, GitLab, and Azure DevOps.
Managed source control and build tools using Git, Bitbucket, Maven, and Gradle.
Achieved 90%+ test coverage with JUnit and Mockito, ensuring maintainability and high code quality.
Conducted API validation and performance testing using Postman and JMeter, ensuring reliability under load.
Collaborated in Agile/Scrum environments—participating in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives for timely delivery.
Partnered with QA, DevOps, and Product teams to ensure smooth release cycles and production stability.
Implemented secure authentication/authorization via JWT, Spring Security, and OAuth2, ensuring compliance with HIPAA and PCI DSS.
Leveraged AWS and Azure services for cloud deployment, API Gateway management, and scalable infrastructure.
Managed application servers such as Tomcat, WebLogic, and Spring Cloud for distributed deployments.
Modernized legacy systems by migrating Java 8 monoliths to microservices architectures, improving performance and maintainability.
Authored technical design documents, UML diagrams, and deployment guides, contributing to end-to-end solution clarity.
Led client interactions, including requirement analysis, technical walkthroughs, and demo sessions for stakeholders.
Enhanced system performance through backend query optimization, API response tuning, and front-end rendering improvements.
